def factor_adx_linear_momentum_ema30_blend20_25(df):
    df_copy = df.copy()
    high = df_copy["high"]
    low = df_copy["low"]
    close = df_copy["close"]
    
    # ---- Manual ADX (14) ----
    period = 14
    prev_close = close.shift(1)
    tr = np.maximum(high - low,
                    np.maximum((high - prev_close).abs(),
                               (low - prev_close).abs()))
    atr = tr.ewm(alpha=1/period, min_periods=period).mean()
    
    up_move = high - high.shift(1)
    down_move = low.shift(1) - low
    plus_dm = np.where((up_move > down_move) & (up_move > 0), up_move, 0.0)
    minus_dm = np.where((down_move > up_move) & (down_move > 0), down_move, 0.0)
    plus_dm = pd.Series(plus_dm, index=df_copy.index)
    minus_dm = pd.Series(minus_dm, index=df_copy.index)
    
    atr_eps = atr.replace(0.0, np.nan)
    plus_di = 100 * (plus_dm.ewm(alpha=1/period, min_periods=period).mean() / atr_eps)
    minus_di = 100 * (minus_dm.ewm(alpha=1/period, min_periods=period).mean() / atr_eps)
    dx = (np.abs(plus_di - minus_di) / (plus_di + minus_di).replace(0.0, np.nan)) * 100
    adx = dx.ewm(alpha=1/period, min_periods=period).mean()
    # ------------------------
    
    ema30 = close.ewm(span=30, min_periods=30).mean()
    pct_diff = (close - ema30) / ema30
    blend = np.clip((adx - 20) / 5.0, 0.0, 1.0)
    factor = (2.0 * blend - 1.0) * pct_diff
    
    df_copy["factor_adx_linear_momentum_ema30_blend20_25"] = factor
    return df_copy["factor_adx_linear_momentum_ema30_blend20_25"]
description: Repaired version of mutation of parent factor_adx_linear_momentum. Preserves core regime-gated momentum mechanism but replaces 50-day SMA with 30-day EMA. ADX blend range narrowed to 20–25. ADX computed manually with pandas to avoid talib runtime unavailability. Smoothing uses Wilder's method (ewm alpha=1/14). No cross-sectional transform, preserving parent's rank-order stability.
